title: Machine-learning thermographic indices validated for rheumatoid arthritis activity
summary: Three hand-thermography indices (ThermoJIS, ThermoDAI, ThermoDAI-CRP) from a pre-trained model were tested in 77 patients at three hospitals over 12 weeks. ThermoDAI and ThermoDAI-CRP correlated with CDAI, SDAI and DAS28-CRP cross-sectionally (rho 0.81, 0.83, 0.78) and longitudinally (about 0.55 to 0.61). The cohort is small and the study observational.
ai_technology: Pre-trained machine learning model producing hand-thermography indices

evidence.tested: Prospective 12-week external validation of previously trained indices.
evidence.unknown: The model is not named and clinical benefit is not tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Produced joint inflammation and disease activity indices from thermograms.
